QUEST.name: Quest
QUEST.tip: Starts in your opening hand. Played, it waits beside your hero, in sight of both players, until its goal is met; then its Reward goes to your hand. One Quest at a time.

UNTOUCHABLE.name: Dormant
UNTOUCHABLE.tip: Holds its place on the board but can't attack, be attacked, targeted or harmed, and doesn't count as a minion.

ADAPT.name: Adapt
ADAPT.tip: Choose one of three random upgrades: +3 Attack, +3 Health, +1/+1, Taunt, Divine Shield, Windfury, Poisonous, Stealth until your next turn, can't be targeted by spells or Hero Powers, or "Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Plants."

VAN_EX1_136.text: Secret: When a friendly minion dies, return it to life with 1 Health.

VAN_NEW1_016.text: Battlecry: Draw a Pirate from your deck.
